rojgarNirman.title: Introduction

intro.p1: 'Rojgar and Nirman' is a popular regular publication that caters to the needs of the youth, with approximately one lakh copies published every week. In addition to the youth, its reach to every Gram Panchayat makes it an authentic document for accessing information about government activities. Departments like the Health Department regularly leverage its reach. ...
intro.p2: 'Rojgar and Nirman' weekly newspaper is a prestigious publication of the Madhya Pradesh Madhyam, the creative undertaking of the Department of Public Relations, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The publication of this weekly paper was started in February 1984 with the objective of providing information to unemployed youth and those striving for better employment opportunities, and to make them aware of their preferred careers. The newspaper's office is located in Bhopal. ...
intro.p3: This weekly newspaper stylishly publishes information related to jobs in the Central Government, State Government, Public Sector Undertakings, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, admission notifications for professional courses, examination notifications from organizations like Union Public Service Commission, Staff Selection Commission, Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission, and other general recruitment bodies, results, and career promotion opportunities at various levels. The aim of this weekly is to provide special information to candidates for public service, those participating in competitive exams and interviews, and youth and professionals concerned with career selection. ...
intro.p4: It is noteworthy that in addition to fulfilling its social responsibilities for which this newspaper was started, 'Rojgar and Nirman' has been continuously earning profits. 'Rojgar and Nirman' also holds the distinction of being the weekly newspaper with the largest circulation in the state, which is available every Monday across the state. ...
intro.p5: Keeping in mind the online needs of unemployed youth and those striving for good employment opportunities in the Hindi-speaking region, the website of 'Rojgar and Nirman' has been launched. ...
